posts.headline: Twenty-three editions running and Thicks is STILL the only unbeaten contender at 4-0, but a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish means I'm not buying this ring until the schedule bites back.
posts.detail: 530.16 points through four weeks is solid, not scary — Tyrique14 has a title in the case but a career mark that's basically a coin flip.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 0-4 freefall has officially outlasted every excuse — a 20-8 career record and league-best 1.5 average finish are now just numbers on a tombstone.
posts.detail: adambarner111 built a 20-8 résumé across two seasons and is somehow 0-4 with 453.58 points, the most undefeated losing streak Busters Anonymous has ever seen.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh falls further into the abyss at 1-3, and a 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12 average finish says this isn't a slump, it's a permanent address.
posts.detail: 444.18 points for talentedtenthh is middling, but the real story is a career built entirely on finishing last — the name writes itself every single week.

posts.headline: Sasinci stays stuck at 2-2 and Big Head's 13-15 career mark keeps whispering that this ring was a fluke, not a foundation.
posts.detail: 491.06 points and a .500 record is fine for most teams, but Alxgalvn's title-winning pedigree demands more than fine — the Milk Man falsetto is still cracking.

posts.headline: The Clown Show keeps grinding at 3-1 with 509.7 points, and btkempski's delusional Packers-superfan swagger is finally matched by a roster that's actually winning.
posts.detail: A 15-13 career record and a 4 average finish make this a prove-it season for btkempski, and so far the Bull Worm is proving it.
